_comment: Consumed by `protolabs-sync-assets` (bin shipped from @protolabsai/design >= 0.3.0). Each key is a target dir, relative to repo root; the value selects which marks from the package's assets/ to copy. '*' mirrors the full set. NOTE: schema is the documented flat-map shape; verify against the published bin when wiring it up (see bead: wire protolabs-sync-assets). Until then ORBIS renders an inlined copy of the mark (web/src/components/ProtoLabsIcon.tsx).
